episodes.title: DOJ to shield Quiboloy from capital punishment in U S  extradition case
episodes.description:
Detained religious leader Apollo Quiboloy will not face capital punishment should he be convicted in the United States. This was the assurance made by the Justice Department. Chief State Counsel Dennis Arvin Chan stressed that protecting Quiboloy from the death penalty is a key consideration in the proceedings. There is still no decision on the U.S. extradition request. The DOJ is currently reviewing the extradition documents recently received from U.S. authorities. The United States is seeking Quiboloy’s extradition on serious charges, including conspiracy to engage in sex trafficking, sex trafficking of children, and bulk cash smuggling. Quiboloy has denied all accusations, maintaining that the cases against him are politically and religiously motivated.

episodes.title: DFA forwards US extradition request for Quiboloy to DOJ
episodes.description:
The DFA has forwarded to the DOJ the U.S. extradition request for detained religious leader Apollo Quiboloy. Quiboloy is facing sex trafficking and other criminal charges in the U.S. The DOJ will determine whether the request complies with the bilateral extradition treaty and Philippine law. In the Philippines, Quiboloy is also facing separate criminal cases, including qualified human trafficking and child abuse charges. He is currently under government custody. Reacting to the extradition request, Quiboloy’s lawyer Ferdinand Topacio described it as “extremely unfeasible.” Topacio said Quiboloy’s criminal cases before Philippine courts are still ongoing. 

Read more: http://tmt.news/2400745

episodes.title: BREAKING: US asks PH to extradite Quiboloy over sex crime charges
episodes.description:
The United States is asking the Philippine government to extradite religious leader Apollo Quiboloy. Quiboloy is facing trial in the US on child sex trafficking and fraud charges. He allegedly had sex with women and underage girls who faced threats of abuse. In the Philippines, the 76-year-old Quiboloy is accused of human trafficking and child abuse. The preacher has denied the allegations. He said they were fabricated by critics and former members who were removed from his religious group.

episodes.title: 'King of the World' statue shows Trump with Epstein in DC
episodes.description:
'King of the World' statue shows Trump with Epstein in DC

A new art installation by the anonymous artist collective Secret Handshake appeared this week on the National Mall in Washington, D.C., depicting figures representing President Donald Trump and the late financier Jeffrey Epstein.

The installation, titled "King of the World," portrays the two figures in a recreation of an iconic scene from the film Titanic featuring characters Jack and Rose.

Plaques placed alongside the sculpture reference allegations of social connections between Trump and Epstein. The installation also includes a row of large banners featuring an image of the two men together.

episodes.title: Police continue search for Quiboloy at church compound in Davao City
episodes.description:
Police continue search for Quiboloy at church compound in Davao City

Police continue its search for Kingdom of Jesus Christ Pastor Apollo Quiboloy at the church compound in Davao City on Sept. 3, 2024, the 11th day since troops were deployed to the city to serve a warrant of arrest on the self-proclaimed 'son of God' on charges of human trafficking and child abuse, among others.
